gen-comfortaa-gf-kulim-park: A wide-open ring of a c gives Comfortaa its whole personality, every stroke bent like neon tubing. Kulim Park stays approachable with wide gaps in the e, while Comfortaa earns its keep when big and short.
gen-comfortaa-gf-kumbh-sans: Kumbh Sans is plain sans drawn with a fixed pen, terminals cut well short of the bowl. And across pages of text it stays quiet, leaving the stretched spacing of Comfortaa to do the talking.
gen-comfortaa-gf-lato: Comfortaa draws every stroke like friendly neon tubing. Lato, a sans-serif with wide s curves barely curled in, takes the text, and Comfortaa earns its keep big and short.
gen-comfortaa-gf-libre-franklin: Comfortaa draws contrast-free strokes from stem to terminal, stretched out like an uncoiled spring. Libre Franklin comes in below with a splayed c terminal, so the friendly heading and clean sans text sit together easily.
gen-comfortaa-gf-livvic: Livvic reads plain sans, with no stress in its curves. What stands out most is friendliness: the ring-like c of Comfortaa and the generous c opening of Livvic both welcome you in.
gen-comfortaa-gf-lunasima: Lunasima keeps its c tips from ever creeping toward touching, which gives the body text a clean, contemporary openness beside Comfortaa. Page after page, it stays easy going on the eye.
gen-comfortaa-gf-m-plus-1: The wide-open ring of a c in Comfortaa, bent like neon tubing, leads before M PLUS 1 arrives with fineliner-flat lines. Next to each other they feel like glowing tubes meeting a fineliner.
gen-comfortaa-gf-m-plus-1p: M PLUS 1p reads clean, a sans-serif with openness at every curve end, and it lets Comfortaa lead. Fixed-nib roundness meeting open curve endings is the standout.
gen-comfortaa-gf-m-plus-2: M PLUS 2 draws one fixed nib width with a gaping c opening, approachable and professional in tone. And next to Comfortaa, the geometric heading and this sans-serif text share a rounded, friendly look.
gen-comfortaa-gf-m-plus-code-latin: M PLUS Code Latin reads like neon tubing bent into letters, each c a wide pitcher mouth. And Comfortaa looks best large for headings, with the text a notch or two smaller.
